answer_2.quote: For each dataset, we measure the following properties: i) Flip rate (Flip), ii) Edit distance (Dist), iii) Content Preservation (Cont), and iv) Fluency.

answer_4.quote: A total of 75 participants with backgrounds in data science, engineering and business analytics voluntarily took part in user studies (37 in study 1 and 38 in study 2).
answer_4.guideline: The task given to users was to determine the classification of the article based on a contrastive explanation from one of the respective methods. For each (anonymized) explanation method, we additionally asked the users for their qualitative assessment along four dimensions; completeness, sufficiency, satisfaction and understandability based on a 5 point Likert scale.
